messages:
maya_devex: Found a nasty edge-case in the async Python client when a request hits a transient 5xx and also times out locally. Auth header gets dropped on the replay and our non-idempotent create endpoint created duplicates for a customer.

leo_sdk: oh no. which SDK version and retry/backoff configuration?

maya_devex: 0.9.4-rc3. default retry policy (exponential with decorrelated jitter), per-request timeout 1.5s. Minimal repro attached below; behavior reproducible in CI with a fake upstream that returns 502 then succeeds.

maya_devex: ```python
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def make():
    client = AsyncClient(api_key="sk-test-xyz", timeout=1.5)
    # user passes Idempotency-Key header manually today
    resp = await client.post("/v1/items", json={"title":"dup-test"}, headers={"Idempotency-Key":"k-123"})
    print(resp.status_code, await resp.text())

asyncio.run(make())
```

sam_infra: can you paste transport logs and trace id? curious if timeout cancellation races with retry queueing.

maya_devex: logs: 

```
-> POST /v1/items
-> Headers: Authorization: Bearer sk-test-xyz
<- 502 Bad Gateway
ClientTimeoutError after 1.5s (cancelled)
Retrying attempt 2
-> POST /v1/items
-> Headers: Idempotency-Key: k-123
<- 201 Created
```

maya_devex: last request succeeded but without Authorization header. server treated it as unauthenticated create and inserted a new item.

leo_sdk: looks like our retry builder reconstructs the original request from a saved body + any explicit headers but doesn't reapply auth that comes from the auth plugin/middleware. timeout path might drop plugin state. We should preserve transport-level auth or re-run auth plugin when replaying. Also we need to make sure timeout cancellation doesn't still enqueue a retry.

rita_pm: this affected a pilot customer. severity P1? duplicates are bad. What's the mitigation for users today?

maya_devex: mitigation: set client.session.headers["Authorization"] at init or use a custom auth header passed into transport config. Not great for UX. Also suggested adding an idempotency_key param on high-level helpers so users don't forget headers.

leo_sdk: filing issue and patch. Plan: 1) preserve auth headers when rebuilding retry requests, 2) ensure auth plugin is reapplied on replay if it provides per-request auth, 3) add unit tests for timeout->retry races, 4) add convenience param idempotency_key to post/create helpers that automatically sets header and logs a warning for non-idempotent endpoints.

sam_infra: will also add integration test in CI that simulates 502 + local timeout to validate we don't drop auth or double-create.

ci-bot: CI: reproducer integration test added on branch fix/auth-on-retry-2112 (will run nightly and on PR).

leo_sdk: assigned PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/pull/2112 — patch includes fix + tests + changelog entry. Please review quickly.

maya_devex: added the tiny sample + cURL trace to the PR description. thanks all. :thumbsup:

rita_pm: thx. schedule canary and send a customer note once deployed.
